{{Quote|The Red Desert is beautiful and daunting, barren and silent. It is a place that would inspire poets and madmen...it would be easy to lose oneself out here.|[[Lanoree Brock]]|<ref name="Into the Void" />}}
The '''Red Desert''' was a desert located in the southern region of [[Talss]], a continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].

==Description==
A remote and ancient place, the Red Desert was a place that attracted explorers and people who sought to severe ties to civilization. A bizarre half planet, half animal called [[Blood spite/Legends|blood spites]] flew low to the ground and sought out warm blood. The haunted nature of the Red Desert was compounded by the ancient and abandoned [[Old City (Tython)|Old City]], a sprawling and giant compound located deep in the Red Desert. The [[Je'daii Order]] had explored the city and failed to locate the hypergate, its existence falling into myth and legend. Rumors abounded that a [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] [[hypergate]] existed deep below the surface; a fable that inspired the Frontiersman [[Osamael Or]] to explore and disappear from history.<ref name="Into the Void" />
